t: Jim Cramer: "Bear Stearns is fine" · CNBC 2008
ot: Jim Cramer: "Bear Stearns is Fine!" Tues, 3/11/08

mentions.x: …of wisdom like this with "Bear Sterns is fine!" just 5 days before they were sold for $2 a share: [video] I really thought his Daily Show appearance would be the beginning of the end for him, but…
Somehow Jim Cramer with his infamous Bear Sterns prediction comes to mind: [video] Note that Jim Cramer is still running his show.
…with how strongly he was certain. "Should I be worried about Bear Stearns in terms of liquidity and get my money out of there? No, NO, NO!!!" (Afterwards... 90% loss in the next 6 days.) [video]
Maybe not that exact phrase but it does conjure to mind the video of Cramer saying Bear Stearns was fine. [video]
